command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/selective-tape-restore
req="$base/restore-request.txt"
arc="$base/tapes/friday.tar"
awk 'NF == 0 || $0 ~ /^\// || $0 ~ /(^|\/)\.\.($|\/)/ || $0 ~ /^-/ { print "unsafe request line " NR ": " $0 > "/dev/stderr"; bad=1 } END { exit bad }' "$req"
requested=$(wc -l < "$req")
matched=0
while IFS= read -r member; do
  [ -n "$member" ] || { printf 'blank request entry\n' >&2; exit 1; }
  count=$(tar -tf "$arc" | awk -v wanted="$member" '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n+0}')
  [ "$count" -eq 1 ] || { printf 'archive match count for %s: %s\n' "$member" "$count" >&2; exit 1; }
  type=$(tar -tvf "$arc" "$member" | awk 'NR==1 {print substr($1,1,1)}')
  [ "$type" = '-' ] || { printf 'requested member is not regular file: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1; }
  matched=$((matched + 1))
  printf 'validated %s (archive_sha256=' "$member"
  tar -xOf "$arc" "$member" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1 ")"}'
done < "$req"
[ "$matched" -eq "$requested" ]
printf 'safe_request_entries=%s unique_regular_archive_matches=%s\n' "$requested" "$matched"

command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/selective-tape-restore
arc="$base/tapes/friday.tar"
live="$base/live"
req="$base/restore-request.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- requested invoice byte/mode verification ---'
while IFS= read -r member; do
  tar -xOf "$arc" "$member" | cmp -s - "$live/$member" || { printf 'byte mismatch: %s\n' "$member" >&2; exit 1; }
  archived_mode=$(tar -tvf "$arc" "$member" | awk 'NR==1 {print substr($1,2,9)}')
  live_mode=$(stat -c '%A' "$live/$member" | cut -c2-10)
  [ "$archived_mode" = "$live_mode" ] || { printf 'mode mismatch: %s archive=%s live=%s\n' "$member" "$archived_mode" "$live_mode" >&2; exit 1; }
  printf '%s bytes=match mode=%s sha256=' "$member" "$(stat -c '%a' "$live/$member")"
  sha256sum "$live/$member" | awk '{print $1}'
done < "$req"
printf '%s\n' '--- preservation and exclusivity verification ---'
customer_hash=$(sha256sum "$live/customers.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$customer_hash" = '0f060a93ce03b8a38e00181862fc775d127160011235f60f4d040afd98e84d51' ]
[ ! -e "$live/old-notes.txt" ]
actual=$(find "$live" -xdev -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort)
expected=$(printf '%s\n' customers.csv; sort "$req")
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { printf 'unexpected live file set\nactual:\n%s\nexpected:\n%s\n' "$actual" "$expected" >&2; exit 1; }
printf 'customers.csv unchanged sha256=%s mode=%s\n' "$customer_hash" "$(stat -c '%a' "$live/customers.csv")"
printf 'old-notes.txt absent=yes\n'
printf 'exact live file set:\n%s\n' "$actual"
printf '%s\n' '--- source and platform unchanged ---'
sha256sum "$req" "$arc"
printf 'os_release=%s kernel=%s tar_package=%s\n' "$(. /etc/os-release; printf '%s' "$PRETTY_NAME")" "$(uname -r)" "$(rpm -q tar)"
printf '%s\n' '--- health ---'
systemctl is-system-running
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager
ss -lntup
df -h /srv

  archived_mode=$(tar -tvf "$arc" "$member" | awk 'NR==1 {print substr($1,2,9)}')
  live_mode=$(stat -c '%A' "$live/$member" | cut -c2-10)
  [ "$archived_mode" = "$live_mode" ]
  printf '%s bytes=archive-match mode=%s sha256=' "$member" "$(stat -c '%a' "$live/$member")"
  sha256sum "$live/$member" | awk '{print $1}'
done < "$req"
customer_hash=$(sha256sum "$live/customers.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$customer_hash" = '0f060a93ce03b8a38e00181862fc775d127160011235f60f4d040afd98e84d51' ]
[ ! -e "$live/old-notes.txt" ]
actual=$(find "$live" -xdev -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort)
expected=$(printf '%s\n' customers.csv; sort "$req")
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ]
printf 'customers.csv unchanged sha256=%s mode=%s\n' "$customer_hash" "$(stat -c '%a' "$live/customers.csv")"
printf 'old-notes.txt absent=yes\nexact_live_file_set:\n%s\n' "$actual"
printf '%s\n' '--- platform/source/health proof ---'
sha256sum "$req" "$arc"
printf 'os_release=%s kernel=%s tar_package=%s\n' "$(. /etc/os-release; printf '%s' "$PRETTY_NAME")" "$(uname -r)" "$(rpm -q tar)"
printf 'failed_units:\n'; systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager
printf 'listeners:\n'; ss -lntup
printf 'disk:\n'; df -h /srv
